🚀 univer-workspace | TypeScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide a collaborative, AI-enhanced office workspace for creating, managing, and reviewing documents and data, suitable for both individual and team use, with options for automation.
✨ Key Features: • Unified office suite (Sheets, Docs, Slides, Bases, Boards) • Real-time co-editing and collaboration
📖 Summary: Univer Workspace is an open-source, self-hostable office suite that integrates documents, spreadsheets, presentations, and databases into a unified environment. It facilitates collaboration between human users and AI agents for content creation, review, and automation, offering multiple entry points like a browser, agent, and CLI.
